description: Look up an existing coupon or reusable savings card using its returned share_token. Never creates a card. For a new reusable card use get_discount_card and retain its cardSessionId. Returns BIN/PCN/Group/Member ID and a share link.

share_token.description: Exact shareToken returned with an existing coupon or reusable card; never invent a token
